data.name: Shirish
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Shri’ meaning ‘wealth, fortune’, and the word ‘Rish’ meaning ‘sage or scholar’. The name Shirish symbolizes the wealth and wisdom of a sage or scholar. It is also associated with the rose apple fruit, which is considered auspicious and is believed to bring blessings.
